summary: Megan Holdings Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-40 share consolidation approved by shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting on August 21, 2026. The consolidation is effective on Nasdaq as of September 8, 2026, with trading to commence on a post-consolidation basis under symbol MGN. Fractional shares will be rounded up to the nearest whole share at the participant level. No other terms or advisors were disclosed. This reverse split reduces share count but does not return capital or change shareholder value. Watch for potential delisting risk if price falls post-consolidation.
